misconfig_patterns: Default quickstart exposes all endpoints without authentication
GET /v1/models lists all loaded models (LLMs, embeddings, rerankers, image, audio, video) without auth
POST /v1/embeddings open — embedding oracle at population scale
POST /v1/chat/completions open when LLM loaded alongside embedding model — full LLM inference free
React web UI at /ui/ exposes model launch controls — arbitrary model loading may be possible without auth
Prometheus /metrics exposes request counts and latency without auth

active_probe.false_positive_check: response must be JSON array containing model_uid and model_type fields; title:Xinference in HTML root is high-confidence

deployment_tells: 484 Shodan hits on http.html:"xinference" (2026-05-09 survey) — largest single-platform embedding hit count
Chinese-origin platform from Xorbits; Chinese cloud providers dominant (Alibaba, Tencent, Huawei)
Multi-modal: supports LLM + embedding + reranker + image + audio + video model types simultaneously
React web UI at /ui/ with model launch/stop controls — no auth gate on default deploy
Often co-deployed with Ollama or LightRAG as the embedding backend
XINFERENCE_TOKEN env var enables bearer-token auth but not set by default
pivot_paths: GET /v1/models → model_uid, model_name, model_type, model_format → identify all loaded models
GET /v1/models/{uid} → model detail → context_length, dimensions, quantization
POST /v1/embeddings {model: uid, input: [text]} → confirm embedding oracle open
GET /ui/ → React bundle → JS secrets extraction (XINFERENCE_TOKEN, API keys in env-injected config)
GET /metrics → Prometheus → request volume per model_uid
